title: Implement the XML citation-resolution check in score.py with controls 1-7 and re-pin (#831 gap, design citation-gap-0206)
body:
## Goal
Close the #831 citation gap as designed in `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md` (`## Design`, `## Controls`, `## Recommendation`). Today `citation_support` (score.py:67-74) only checks dict identity against the key and never opens the artifact. Add `citation_resolves` inside `benchmark/scripts/score.py` (copy `resolve` from `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py:35-60`; do NOT edit or import `check_xml_keys.py`, its sha is pinned in the fixture). Wire it at the grounding branch (around score.py:221-223) and in `extra_outcome` (around score.py:110): any `incorrect` wins, `unverified` blocks `correct`, never upgrade a result. Add an injectable artifact-bytes loader to `compute`/`generate`/`regression_self_test`. Add controls 1-7 from the design to `regression_self_test`. Regenerate `benchmark/results/challenges.json`. Re-pin every changed file in every live pin map.
Files expected to change: `benchmark/scripts/score.py`, `benchmark/results/challenges.json`, `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`, `benchmark/preparation.json` (and `benchmark/preparation-status.json` only if it mirrors those hashes). Leave the `answer_record_contract` string shape unchanged in this task; record the mismatch as a finding instead.
Expected gain: the next shaper reads in your report the control table (control, expected, actual) and that control 4 (self-consistent key with wrong locator) now gives `incorrect`.
No session can run LabVIEW: claim nothing about native behaviour (N0001/N0002 stay native-unverified).

## Acceptance
- [ ] First step recorded in the report: how the scorer reaches the artifact bytes for a citation path (via `benchmark/sources.json` and `LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT`), with file and line references. If the bytes cannot be reached, the loader returns nothing and the outcome is `unverified`, never `correct`.
- [ ] `benchmark/scripts/score.py` defines `citation_resolves` and calls it in both the grounding branch and `extra_outcome`.
- [ ] `regression_self_test` contains controls 1-7 of citation-gap-0206 `## Controls` with their expected outcomes written before running; all pass; existing controls keep their outcomes (report any that changed with the reason).
- [ ] `benchmark/results/challenges.json` regenerated by score.py with `python3 -B -I`; `git status --porcelain` shows no `__pycache__`.
- [ ] Every entry of `protected_inputs_sha256` in `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` and every path/sha256 entry in `benchmark/preparation.json` matches disk after the change (recompute all, not just changed ones); report counts from the files.
- [ ] `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` unchanged.
- [ ] Report has the control table and remaining limits (no native meaning, no reader fidelity).

## Verification
python3 -c "import json,hashlib; p=json.load(open('benchmark/writing/input-pins.json'))['protected_inputs_sha256']; bad=[k for k,v in p.items() if hashlib.sha256(open(k,'rb').read()).hexdigest()!=v]; assert not bad, bad; s=open('benchmark/scripts/score.py').read(); assert 'def citation_resolves' in s and s.count('citation_resolves(')>=3; print('pins and citation check: OK')"

## Context
- Design and edit points: `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md` (#885, accepted iteration 0206).
- Pin lesson: a change to a pinned file re-pins every live map (#857 f4, #861 f1); #881 did it right.
- Bytecode trap: run benchmark python as `python3 -B -I` and check `git status --porcelain` (#785). `-I` drops the script dir from sys.path.
- Long inline python one-liners stall (#743): put helpers in files under `.session/artifacts/`, not the repository.
- Do not run `git commit`; the parent commits.
- Tools: if the CLI says "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session", that is a native-tool refusal, not a broker failure; propose the same operation again as a JSON action and never stop on it (#854). Grep is literal substring only.

## Budget
Read whole: `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md`, `benchmark/scripts/score.py`. Read ranges only: `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` lines 1-100, `benchmark/sources.json` (Grep for the artifact path first), `benchmark/challenges/library-specialty.json` (Grep A0002), `benchmark/preparation.json` and `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` only around the entries you change, plus a file-based recomputation script for the full maps. Do not read whole large JSON results; keep command output short. Report early if the artifact bytes cannot be reached.

title: Review the citation-resolution check and its re-pins (changed scope of citation-check-0207)
body:
## Goal
Independently review the changed scope of task citation-check-0207 against the design `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md`. Report, do not fix. Pin the merged commit and the sha256 of `benchmark/scripts/score.py`, `benchmark/results/challenges.json`, `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`, `benchmark/preparation.json` yourself at the start. Expected gain: a CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR verdict with numbered findings that the next shaper reads in your report.
No session can run LabVIEW: assess only XML-text grounding, not native behaviour.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Before opening the producer's report, write in `.session/artifacts/review-expectations.md` your own expected outcome for design controls 1-7 from `## Controls`.
- [ ] Check that `citation_resolves` follows the pass/fail rule in `## Design` (hash gate, locator resolution, exact literal equality, `unverified` never `correct`, no upgrade of a result) and that it is wired in both the grounding branch and `extra_outcome`.
- [ ] Run `python3 -B -I benchmark/scripts/score.py` self-test as the producer documented; confirm controls 1-7 pass and existing control outcomes are unchanged or justified; confirm regeneration reproduces `benchmark/results/challenges.json` byte-for-byte; `git status --porcelain` clean afterwards.
- [ ] Recompute every entry of `protected_inputs_sha256` in `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` and every path/sha256 entry in `benchmark/preparation.json` against disk; report counts from the files.
- [ ] Confirm `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` unchanged against its pinned `oracle.independent_checker.identity.checker_sha256`.
- [ ] Findings and verdict in `.session/report.md`, details in `.session/artifacts/`; no repository writes.

## Verification
python3 -c "s=open('benchmark/scripts/score.py').read(); assert 'def citation_resolves' in s; print('score.py has citation_resolves: OK')"

## Context
- Design: `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md` (#885). Producer task: citation-check-0207 in this graph; its artifacts are staged as inputs if it saved any.
- Diff against the task commit's parent, not HEAD (HEAD may be an epilogue commit, #882). Report `commit:` fields may name an empty commit; verify by hash (#754).
- Tools: if the CLI says "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session", that is a native-tool refusal, not a broker failure; propose the same operation again as a JSON action and never stop on it (#854). Grep is literal substring only.

## Budget
Read whole: `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md`, the diff of `benchmark/scripts/score.py`. Read ranges: `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` lines 30-65, the changed entries in the two pin maps. Use a file-based recomputation script in `.session/artifacts/`. Later read (after the expectations artifact is saved): the producer's report. No whole large JSON reads; short command output.
